coordinate_system: Absolute pixels in each original bank PNG. region=[x,y,width,height]; foot X preserves the estimated pelvis-ground projection, while foot Y is the bottom-exclusive alpha>128 boundary of the visually identified weight-bearing boot. Swinging boots are excluded from this Y measurement. body_height is fixed for each bank and excludes the taller backpack instrument.

registration.root_accuracy: Foot X retains the prior manual pelvis-ground projection estimate. Foot Y was remeasured from the alpha>128 bottom-exclusive boundary of the identified supporting boot, without image changes; back frame 2 is corrected from y=1210 to y=1189. This removes the documented 21-source-pixel registration gap by construction, but dynamic ground contact, gait cadence and gameplay acceptance still require root GPU review.
registration.alpha_measurement: Read-only System.Drawing RGBA scan. Each source frame is isolated and no alpha>16 pixels touch its nominal 2x2 cell boundary. Explicit source regions include 4px padding; near_opaque_fraction counts alpha>=240 among alpha>16 pixels.
registration.body_height_method: One fixed hair-crown-to-pelvis-ground reference per bank, excluding the tall brass backpack instrument. Front hair-crown y is approximately 91/114/699/711 and back 55/54/684/684. Per-frame body height overrides are intentionally absent.
registration.identity_review: Independent source inspection found stable hair bun and flower pin, olive coat, white cloth-wrap and gold-kneepad leg identities, backpack instrument, and a complete low two-handed rifle in all frames.

static_findings: Identity and body proportions remain stable at gameplay scale; all four front/back source poses are readable.
Passing poses remain narrow, and back source frame 2 has a visible gap between both boot silhouettes and the fixture ground line.

Direct source inspection shows intact connected legs and complete boots in back source frame 2. The rearward bent leg exposes its sole as a lifted pose; neither leg is severed or cropped. The lower boot's ground gap is still a registration/foot-plant concern, not accepted merely as lifted-pose design.
pending_acceptance: Watch continuous playback to assess cadence, loop transitions, sole projection, and planted-foot stability.
Review actual player movement, stop-to-idle and attack transitions, and wall contact; this capture uses scripted displacement and does not exercise player physics or combat.

limitations: Four authored key poses per view; not a continuous eight-frame gait and no repeated poses are inserted to inflate frame count.
Passing poses are relatively narrow and restrained; missing down/up in-between frames may cause visible cadence and loop transitions.
Front posture and hair-crown height vary naturally across frames; fixed bank scale preserves this variation rather than resizing each silhouette.

Ground root X remains a visual projection estimate; Y now follows the measured supporting sole. This is not physical motion tracking, and foot sliding or unnatural contact/cadence must still be checked during actual playback.
Two authored front/back views use horizontal mirroring; this is not eight-direction art.
This candidate remains disabled until gameplay-scale front/back playback, idle and attack transitions, and wall-contact review are accepted.
